header.name: Salvage Smelting
header.description: v2.0.0 - Smelt worn gear and iron, gold, copper, diamond or leather goods back into half of what they cost to craft.

modules.description: 75 furnace and blast furnace recipes that return half an item's crafting cost.

settings.text: Salvage Smelting has nothing to configure. This panel is a summary of what the pack does.

Gear and crafted goods smelt into half of what they cost to make, rounded up. An iron chestplate costs 8 ingots and returns 4; a sword costs 2 and returns 1. Durability makes no difference - a furnace recipe cannot see it.

Items crafted in batches pay in nuggets instead, so that salvaging never returns more metal than the item cost. Chainmail returns 1 iron ingot per piece, and bows, crossbows and fishing rods return 2 string.
Fuel use is unchanged. Works in both a furnace and a blast furnace.
